nom: The Ordinary Amino Acids + B5 Hydration Serum

avis.texte: I love tbis stuff. I mix it with my moisturizer and my skin has been looking so plump and healthy. No greasiness.

The amount of moisture *this* product adds is why I keep coming back. On your face, excellent. Add to your body lotion? Game changer! Big time! Emulsify with your favorite body lotion, and see the difference quickly!
Ive used this product for years! Its always being sold out at my location, so i buy them 3 at a time! My favorite product!
I really like this serum it's one of the few serums that I can use daily that don't break me out
I can't be without this serum. I love it. I have been using it for years. I always have a backup.

I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. I combine The Ordinary with COSRX Snail Mucin products and a Mario Badescu toner for the best results. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. I use this after the Pycnogenol to help it absorb into the skin. I'm not sure I need it, but the Pycnogenol recommended it for best results, and I find them effective together.

If you have redness and dry skin, this will be your best friend. This works wonders for my dry skin and calms my redness all Day! The hydration is INCREDIBLE more than any hylaronic acid could ever do for me
I love all Ordinary products. I uses this as an inexpensive way to put moisture in my routine
I love this product because it is not only healthy for my skin but it also calms redness and irritation. It evens out skin tone. Plus you can't ask for a better price, but the bottle could be bigger.
Plumps hydrates protects and my skin drinks it up! Takes the clock hands back dramatically! It's always going to be a staple in my beauty routine

avis.titre: Gluten Free, Great nightly hair serum and healthy eye brow
avis.texte: I realize this product is formulated for faces, but I instead use it about 4x week as a night scalp/hair serum and nightly eyebrow health enhancer. Why? Yes, The Ordinary has hair and eye brow serums, but they all contain wheat/wheat germ oil and I have celiac and react to topical gluten. These products plus the addition of the copper peptides on my eye brows, have helped improve the growth and health of my hair and eye brows. I had lost them when on chemotherapy (breast cancer) and then my eye brows and hair grew back really thin, sparse and weak — and never got better even two years post-chemo. Seven months ago, I started using The Ordinary (daily Niacinamide on my face and this B5 + amino acids (hair snd eye brows) and the B5 + amino acids and also copper peptides (eye brows) and now my facial skin is much healthier and my hair and eye brows are thicker and healthier too.

avis.titre: Trying this product out for a first time.
avis.texte: So, far this product hasn't disappointed me. Using at night.

I use this daily, typically with Niacinamide 10% and Natural Moisturizing Factors, and at night with a retinol added to the mix. I add some other products on occasion (Vit. C, Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptide), but always use this. Nothing has made my skin look so good. I have been out for a few weeks and I notice a dramatic difference in how my skin looks and feels. This combo leaves me with glassy, smooth, hydrated, and hormonal acne-free skin. I will never let myself run out again!
I've been using it for three months and it works for my dry skin.Luv the effects

avis.titre: I never want to run out of this again
avis.texte: I have very dry, dehydrated skin and a rough flakey patch on my face that shows up every winter. This product really keeps it at bay. I use it after cleansing, before moisturizing. I also only need about half as much moisturizer when I use this.

I bought this yesterday and I already see a difference. It put my full dry skin back to life . I also immediately seen a reduction of wrinkles around my mouth the next morning when putting this on my face before bedtime. For my best results I put the serum on then use an aveeno lotion on top. Perfect pair !

I had a reaction to the hyaluronic acid, but I still needed the extra hydration…this works great without the irritation! I've been using it morning and night before niacinimide and moisturizer…amazing combination!

I use a prescription retinoid nightly. I use this amino acid serum as a first step after cleansing and before application of my retold lotion. It provides a layer of protection AND improves my skin. I use this twice daily and could not be happier. I will continually repurchase and I recommend.

I use prescription retinoid nightly. I wanted a serum to moisturize my skin before application. This serum works really well. It makes my skin plumper, hydrated and smoother. It is high on my favorite serums list. I use it twice daily.

Like others who have left reviews, I think this product is really hydrating. I use it when my skin is dehydrated from drinking too much coffee or being in a cold dry environment. I first heard about b5's from a YouTube influencer who said to use it in the winter when your skin is dry. I wish I had known sooner that this product can be combined effectively with peptides. I was skipping peptides on days that I was using this at first. Combining this product with a peptide serum can improve the overall serum texture and benefit. You can also use it at night before a retinol. I find it's uncomfortable when I first put it on my skin but then the sensation goes away and the benefits are fantastic. You might want to dilute it with a bit of oil if you have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: The most hydrating product I've ever used
avis.texte: I have been using this over the past 12 or so months and have repurchased multiple times. Nothing hydrates like this does (and I've tried a lot of different products from many different brands). I have combination skin and can't use face oils or squalane as both cause hectic CCs and breakouts. It hydrates exceptionally (and not just on the surface - it really feels like it works through the layers) and doesn't cause any issues whatsoever. I use this in the evenings as I find that it is slightly oily/sticky feeling (despite being water based) and does feel a bit heavier than some of my other serums, however, the oily/sticky feeling disappears relatively quickly. This product can be layered and I've never had an issue with pilling. 10/10, will forever repurchase.
This is a great hydrator for my skin. I use it twice a day and won't ever be without it. I love the price and how it keeps my skin hydrated.

I simply cannot stand how this product feels on the skin. It feels so sticky to the point I feel it just sits on the surface of the face. I regret purchasing this so-called water-based hydrator, which is too heavy(STICKY to the max).
I love using this on my face morning and night. I have noticed it really helping my skin! It feels super light on my face as well. This is my second bottle so far and won't be my last!

I have dry, often dehydrated skin, I use this every day as a first thing after washing my face. No smell, no texture, very very light watery serum, goes in to the skin immediately, and fits with other serums well. I would recommend!

avis.titre: I would by this product again and again
avis.texte: I love this Amino acid plus B5 serum. I add 2-3 drops to my moisturizer and I get added hydration. My skin loves it and it plumps my skin up. My skin feels hydrated all day. I have recommended to my family and friends. They love it too ! One of my favorites from the Ordinary.

I am so so upset that this has caused me to breakout so badly, even when I was having pimples it was never like this and some are so sore. I will be travelling next week and wanted to make my skin nice and now I have just made it worse… I understand everyone has a different reaction but mine was definitely not good and I am so upset
I started using this product a few day a ago abd the results has been amazing so far. Super hydrating product that leaves my skin smooth and plump.
I absolutely love this serum. It really hydrated my complexion without any greasy feeling. It works wonders with retinol & other serums. I highly recommend this product.

This serum in unbelievably lightweight, but packs a huge hydration punch. I use this serum with my AM ritual under my antioxidant serum & SPF. It absorbs quickly & leaves my skin smooth, dewy & fresh. I highly recommend this product.

I have never had a breakout from using this and I break out easily. I use this in the morning after Hyaluronic acid and before Niacinamide then put sunscreen on and do my make up. At night I have 2 different routines that I mix up 1, I use Hyaluronic acid the Amino acids+B5 then Niacinamide plus retinal product and moisturise 2, I use Hyaluronic acid the Amino acids+B5 then Vitamin C and moisturise. I am 47 and customers at work constantly tell me I look late 20's. they do not believe I have a 24 year old. I personally don't think I look that young but it happens enough that I must not look my age. I look younger in my late forties than I did in my late thirties because of this routine.

i have a dry, sometime flaky t zone and this has cured me. My skin has never looked more hydrated. Leaves a slight tingling sensation. But nothing too crazy. I use this after my vitamin c serum and it lays perfectly.

I can't get part the weird texture of this product. It just makes my skin uncomfortable. I thought I'd try to work it into my night routine because it makes my makeup pill, but it didn't work well with that either. I just can't stand the feeling of it.

avis.titre: The serum feels too oily on my skin
avis.texte: This product is described as water-based serum. I have tried many other water-based serums from The Ordinary, I liked all of them, but this one is different. It's still somehow "oily", or at least it feels like this on my skin when I apply it. The good thing is that it dries on my skin pretty quickly. Also despite being somehow oily, it doesn't clog my pores. I'm happy for that. The bad thing is that when I use this serum, any moisturizer applied on top of it creates white stains. Some moisturizers do it more, some less, I have tried few. But the white marks are always there, so I need to put really just a thin layer of moisturizer and then massage it in.

I use it after all my other serums (hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, matrixyl) and before face cream. I also use this on my lips, every night. It feels good and offers to dry skin the oils that we miss. I just order my 3rd bottle because it's a must have in my routine. At first it might feel a little bit sticky but the sensation disappears after 2 minutes. The skins remains plump, hydrated and luminous (i have dry skin and i use tretinoin 5 night/week) The lips look better and fuller. I totally recommend this product!

avis.titre: Hydrating with a few drops but causes breakouts
avis.texte: This is my first bottle. I have been using this for the past two weeks, only apply it at night because I have combination skin. When I am not applying makeup in the morning I tend to stick to my normal skincare routine. One thing I have noticed though is that since using this serum is causing breakouts on my forehead. I haven't had this for a long time so this is really annoying! I really like this product but decided I have to stop using it because of the breakouts. Any suggestions from anyone because I see few other posts people having similar results but no solutions.

Ordered this in my second TO order. I tried it after cleaning, on it's own, made my face really sticky. I read before bed and my eyelids were sticking to my face! Super annoying. Started using Glycolic Acid, which needs a lot of hydration afterwards. So decided to try this again since I already bought it. I use a pretty strong facial cleanser (Olay Deep Gel Cleaner with Tea Tree Oil). Glycolic Acid 3x a week. Then I use 5 drops of Marine Hyaluronics, 5 drops of this Amino Acid mixed with 2 drops Pycnogenol, then a good moisturizer (w/o HA). This regimen has completely changed my skin! It feels supple (never even understood that word until now) and hydrated and smooth. I can't even believe it! I use only lotion during the day, but this night routine is on point for me! For some reason, adding the 2 drops of Pycnogenol seems to make the Amino Acid less sticky. I really don't know why. Maybe the Marine Hyaluronics helps that too? I don't know, but it really works for me. My eyelids no longer stick, and my skin feels nourished. It's worth a shot, because if you can get this to work for you, it really is a great product!

I bought this product before winter starts and recently started using it. Since I read about the stickiness, I decided to mix this with my Buffet in the same manner that I would also use my Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%, and I never had an issue with stickiness. Unfortunately, I did find that my skin broke out within a day of using it, and the breakout was quite bad and painful. It's not like I never get a pimple, but when I do, it's hormonal and not all over my face. With the use of this product, it's in various places on my face where I haven't had a breakout in a decade or more. I can say that the hydration after I applied the product, is lovely, but the breakouts that came with it means that I will definitely not continue to use it.

Of all the many serums I have tried from the Ordinary, and any other skincare line, this is without a doubt my favorite. I buy it again and again. I would say the best way to describe the effect this has on my fair, dry, sensitive skin is: strength. My skin feels protected, firm, bouncy, and strong after I use it. It is light and feels like a deep drink of water. When I ruined my skin barrier a few years ago I broke out in acne and dry skin patches. This serum helped restore my skin barrier and clear my skin. I'm 29. I have been using this for about 4 years. I wear it morning and night under my moisturizers. It will continue to be a staple of my routine indefinitely.

avis.titre: Adds a nice hydrating film to dry skin
avis.texte: I'm about 3/4 of the way through a bottle and will definitely reorder. I have dry, sensitive skin and I layer many different products in my routine. With this product I have discovered I can use quite a few less products in the morning. My routine: AM; wash with The Ordinary Squalane Cleanser Vitamin C serum Tony Molly Wonder Ceramide Mochi Toner The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors Skin Aqua Super Moisture Gel sunscreen I do find that it makes any products you put on top harder to absorb. I make sure that I let things dry before trying to put my sunscreen on. Takes a little bit longer to get the sunscreen to rub in and dry, but once it's on it looks great! Gives a nice plump glowing look to my face. Don't use too much, three or four drops is plenty

avis.titre: Hydrates but not very comfortable to wear
avis.texte: Hydrates not bad but leaves a bit sticky layer and doesn't get along with all makeup bases. Also, I feel hydration only while it's on my skin. After using it for several months my skin is still dry after each washing even with super gentle cleanser.

I tought this would do good for my dry skin but it doesn't feel very moisturising and skin still feels tight and dry after using this in combo with the HYDRATORSNatural moisturizing factors + ha. I will go back to the Hyaluronic acid 2% + b5 serum . That one leaves my skin realy hydrated.
Watery but sticky. hyaluronic acid seems to be more hydrating
My skin is super sensitive and gets dry in areas of my face. This is a life saver. Leaves my skin soft before applying moisturizer! I use it every morning and night.

I have combo skin, with dry T-zone. I use it both morning and night. I use Retin-A and applying the amino acids before my retin-A has helped with the sensitivity i get when i use it daily. It doesnt feel tacky at all. Very nice product for me. I tend to get acne whenever i try any new product, this only didnt really affect my skin negatively, just nicely hydrated.

This product really does what it claims to do, i.e. hydration. HOWEVER, it saddens me to say that I just found out that it's the culprit for the white, sebaceous threads protruding out of my skin - especially in my T-zone and chin area. It unfortunately aggravates my sebaceous filaments. And it's really bad....I have dark skin, so having 'white hairy-like threads' all over my face isn't pretty. I've had to really up my exfoliating game because of the product. As much as I love TO's hydrators, I think they may be too concentrated. Perhaps, having an option for a diluted version would be more suited for some of us.

I must b on my 3rd bottle by now! Love this for my dehydrated skin,absorbs well with other products layered during the toner stage, no greasy feel n softens the skin well,this is most definitely a underrated product,improves overall look of your skin with long-term use!! Love it!!
The ONLY hydrating product that ACTUALLY works on my skin. I always feel hydrated to the max when I use this as my 1st step in skincare. PLEASE RESTOCK IT. MY SKIN HAS BEEN CRISPY FOR A MONTH WAITING

avis.titre: It left a crispy film on my face
avis.texte: Amino Acid left a crispy film on my face. It made other stuff I applied after it hard to penetrate the film it created. I so much want to like this. But to me, hyaluronic acid seems easier to be absorbed and does not block the passage for other ingredients.

I'm honestly not sure if it's doing anything, I was hoping it would reduce my dark eye circles after reading a review that said it helped, but no such luck. It does feel like it's moisturizing my face but I can't put it on my hormonal acne (which I put salicylic acid on) because it ends up making it more red. This has a water texture so it drips a bit everywhere while you're trying to put drops on your face (and putting it on your hands to then rub on your face doesn't make your face feel as moisturized). Has a fun tingle. Takes a bit of time to sink in, and then I use the ordinary moisturizer. Face feels sticky for a while but hydrated.
I thought this would add moisture but it added pimples. 5%Pycnogenol 5% is working great though.

avis.titre: A must have for dry and mature skin
avis.texte: I've used this for a while and I am going back for more. I only need two drops for application. I used it before anything else with the exception of vitamin c, I would use it after that and I'd wait a bit. I find it helps my moisturiser work better for me and my skin looks like it has more glow.

This was my first purchase from the ordinary and honestly didn't know what to expect. I'm mid 30s, have extremely fair skin with brown freckles and most of the time my skin looks very dull and meh. After a week of this serum my skin has never looked better! Not only is it more hydrated and smooth, it makes my skin look really healthy and is fabulous under makeup. I have now even got my husband using it and he loves it aswell. I highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: A staple for my 45 year old dry skin
avis.texte: Experimenting a lot with Deciem products but this is the only product that I am never without. Hydrates really well, and I haven't felt any stickiness that some mentioned - though I don't wait for it to dry completely before layering the rest of my routine (usually vitamin c of some sort, squalane and moisturizer)

I love how this keeps my skin hydrated but I get milia or tiny bumps on my face because of it. I know it's this product that's causing it. Every time I stopped it went away and every time I started using it, it unfortunately came back. Anybody have any advice if you went through something similar? I use about 4 drops on damp face. If nothing works, I'll use it on my body so it doesn't go to waste. I'm also looking for an alternative with the same properties.

This has been tingling when I use and it says to dilute in cream or serum on the back if it's a bit to much so I rather than use it first on bare skin, I apply it after my cocokind ceramide serum and before my cicaplast balm and finish off with tret. It's basically water consistency. Not sure if it has helped my hydration as I bought it specifically for the 5% panthenol. The combination I mentioned above has worked wonderfully well however and I may take a break after I finish the bottle to see if I notice a difference.

avis.titre: a must have for me, mature combination skin
avis.texte: I got this with the EUK 134 a few years ago, and did a patch test on my arm. I washed a large spot on my arm, then applied the Amino Acids + B5, let it dry a bit, then put the EUK over the top. In the morning, not only did I like the improved texture and hydration, much to my surprise that area was noticeably brighter and had a more even skin tone! The Amino Acids + B5 is particularly appreciated because it can be used under pretty much anything. I can not use the various versions of the Buffet, or whatever they are calling it now, because it contains some ingredients that aren't for me. Yes, it is a wee bit sticky as others have mentioned, but I have found waiting a few seconds and putting something hydrating on top takes care of that. I tend to be allergic and sensitive to things, and I don't react to this - it seems to help keep my skin calm. I don't remember now how many bottles of this I have used. It's a go to. (As an aside to deciem - please do not put squalene/squalane in this - I can not use anything with that ingredient in it. I mention it as someone suggested they might prefer it in a squalane base. I would also appreciate it if squalene/squalane could be added to your list of 'ingredients at a glance' to make it easier to avoid.)

avis.titre: If you are buying one serum it should be this
avis.texte: This serum is a literal dream. It makes my skin so hydrated, plump and smooth. It sinks into my skin instantly and is so light in texture. I don't even need to use moisturiser because this does a much better job at hydrating my skin. My skin looks and feels so much nicer and make up sits much better on my skin now.

avis.titre: Great for very dry skin if consistent
avis.texte: I started with this for my skin care journey. Being 37 with fine lines and dry skin, it healed up my skin. One bottle lasts 3-4 months if using daily am and pm. Only need 3-4 drops at a time on damp skin. My skin has again started glowing like my earlier days.

My skin requires more hydration than is available in most Ordinary formulations - Buffet, Copper Peptide, etc - and I can't love anything feeling sticky on my skin. The amino acid serum helps to solve all of those issues with just a few drops.

I mistakenly put Amino Acids +B5 under my eye area before bed. In the morning I awoke to dramatically reduced dark circles. Thought it may have been a fluke & or some other contributing factor. Applied again the next evening to wake with the same result. This was over 3 yrs ago & I use this every night & morning under my eyes. GAME CHANGER for me!! Please please never ever stop making this wonderful serum! If I could give it 100 stars I would.

I have normal to dry skin with some fine lines. I pair this with hyaluronic acid daily and it is GREAT for hydration support. I noticed a difference within a week after using once daily in the tightness, plumpness and hydration of my skin. I also noticed some decrease in my fine lines and pores, but this could be from another ordinary product i started using at the same time. I love this product, I feel like the glow it gives me sticks around throughout the day and it is great under makeup!

I used to have oily, dehydrated skin that was prone to occasional acne (even in my mid 40s). I've been using this for 3-4 years, and I gave to say that the oil is completely gone as well as the acne. To top it off, my skin feels so healthy and moisturized. These amino acids produce majorly glowy skin andhelp support collagen! It's an everyday product for me.

avis.titre: The most hydrating product in my arsenal.
avis.texte: I've used this product for about a week now and this is by far the most hydrating product in my arsenal. My skin was very dehydrated and had almost Saran Wrap like texture. As soon as I apply this serum, my skin texture softens and shines. The serum adds a very nice glow to the skin that stays even after I put a moisturizer on top. My skin is not overly sensitive; so I tolerate it very well and have no reaction to it. Some might experience some tingling from it per manufacturer's label. The formula does seem to be very concentrated. I absolutely love it and happy I discovered it.

Hyaluronic acid dries my skin. This serum hydrates like nothing I've used before. I've used it twice daily for a month & can now skip using primer. I haven't noticed any improvement to wrinkles or sun damage, but it works better than a moisturizer. I highly recommend it if you have dry skin. Pros: No scent, absorbs quickly, hydrates, inexpensive Cons: Gets sticky if you use too much product, watery
My skin looks and feels great, I use this in the morning after washing my face and apply moisturizer on top.

I love this product. Keeps my face soft and supple. I would love to have it in a bigger size though, because my skin drinks it up. I use 4-6 drops to a freshly washed face. Would love to see The Ordinary come up with body moisturizers or serums that contains amino acids.
This serum is a must in my skincare regimen. I buy several different serums so that I can tailor it to my skin's specific needs.

avis.titre: holy grail - make it in a bigger size
avis.texte: I absolutely love this serum - It's the most underrated The Ordinary product,IMO. Because of its watery consistency, it's perfect to layer with your current skincare,specially during warmer months when you can get oilier. At night I use this serum in combination with my moisturizer; during the day,I use it with a hydrating toner. I sometimes use TO's hyaluronic acid serum,but the consistency is not my favorite; I keep coming back to this one.

avis.titre: No idea what it's doing but DON'T STOP
avis.texte: I forget how I even ended up buying this. I use it before the hyaluronic acid which is great in its own right. Adding this has almost immediately changed how my skin feels, holds moisture, and reacts to the world around me. I think I have combination skin but it's really just dry and aging (whatever that means). This (while VERY runny) absorbs very well into my skin. I see less texture issues (dry, patchy, rough etc) and a reduction of fine lines. I use it daily with an arbitrary Ordinary system. For the effect and price, this was an absolute win and a surprise find.

avis.titre: Please make this in a bigger size, it's fantastic!
avis.texte: Went through my first bottle of this in a month and few days, I have combination skin, that gets dry due to prescribed tretinoin (0.05%) and this has helped my flakey and irritated skin so much. Hyaluronic acid doesn't work for my skin, but this does. The texture is like a dream, watery so it sinks right in and works as it should. But since I go through the bottle so quickly, I keep having to order two bottles at a time which feels like a waste of the bottles and the droppers. So please consider making this in a bigger size!

This is the only product that really helps my dry skin. I first started using this when I had a lot of breakouts of small itchy bumps (somewhere between acne and eczema) on my face and within 2-3 weeks it cleared completely. At one point I stopped using this serum (I ran out) and within a week the bumps were back. I immediately ordered it again and luckily it cleared my skin again in a week; so I know for sure that this product works! Highly recommended if you suffer from similar issues. Overall it also helps to keep regular acne in check and has made my skin tone more even. My only wish is that it would come in bigger quantities because it's great to use on other areas of the body that suffer from dryness too.

I use this after cleaning my face with foaming gel, and I feel no need for a moisturizer afterwards. I've been using Avene for hypersensitive skin because of it's light formula, but I haven't used it since the summer -- and I always get dry skin in the winter. The liquid is very runny, so use my face-roller to catch and trap the drops. It hasn't improved my texture, and I sometimes get bumpy patches but my skin feels very smooth and elastic.

avis.titre: The stickiest thing I've ever put on my face
avis.texte: It's strange bc out of the bottle, it's a very watery substance. As soon as it touches my face, however, it turns into a tacky/filmy glue. I let it dry and then touched my face and my hand literally was stuck and peeled off of it.

Im angry with myself that i didnt try the ordinary some years ago. I wouldnt have struggled with my skin so much.. my skin always been dry but also oily, big pores, blackheads and pimples. I bought expensive creams and gels but also tried almost everything for oily skin that was sold at the drugstore. My skin felt dry but produced a lot of oil after only 2-3 hours. Now my skin feels totally new. I clean my face morning and evening only with a hot damp towel (always a fresh one), when im wearing make up i rub it off with oil before. Then i spray my face with distilled water, massage 3 drops of niacinamide into my skin, let it dry, spray it again and pat on 5 drops of amino acids, hyaluronic acid around mouth and eyes, spray it again and use 3 drops of squalane. Im so happy with this routine!!! No breakouts, no blackheads, no oily skin, no dry skin. I dont even need to exfoliate regularly anymore. When it feels a little sandy once or twice a month i use some drops of mandelic acid after washing my face and leave it on for 20 minutes before i continue my routine. Wish i figured this out in my twenties.. in a week ill be 31 bc and i have finally the skin i always wanted. Big thanks to the ordinary!!!

This serum is the best hydrating serum I've ever tried. I put it after cleansing on a damp skin before TRETinoin and in the morning before my sunscreen. Never experienced any irritation/flaky skin with it. I always recommend it. thanks
Really good ingredients but don't necessarily for skincare. It's more prevention.

avis.titre: Saved my skin from tretinoin and winter dryness
avis.texte: 5/5 stars because it does exactly what it claims to, nothing more, nothing less I use it day and night (4 drops) immediately after washing my face while it's still a little damp. I've been using tretinoin for four months now (0.025%) and it irritates my skin because winter is already drying. I have cystic acne (hence the tretinoin) and scars from previous acne, so my skin looks pretty dull. Adding Amino Acids +B5 to my routine helped reduce dry flakes and irritation over time, and that made my skin look a less dull and more smooth. As a scarring acne sufferer, I appreciate any smoothness I can get. It's been a month and a half, and whenever I do not use Amino Acid + B5, my dry flaky skin increases, and so does irritation from tretinoin. So, it definitely makes a difference. My dad has eczema in his hand, and he puts a few drops of this to his hand cream before applying, and it has noticeably reduced irritation from dryness for him as well. This is a great product if you suffer from dryness. It worked for me and my dad, but may not work for everyone. So try it and see if it helps you too, and if it does not, DECIEM has a great return policy. I will continue to purchase

A dropper bottle for this is just not it. This stuff is so thin it runs in-between your fingers or all down your face and hands before you even get a chance to apply it. I seriously spill more of it than I end up using! Might work better in some sort of spray bottle application. As far as the product It barely does anything and I'm not gonna waste my time in my routine on this anymore and just opt for a heavier moisturizer/ oil

avis.titre: Broke me out, but found other great uses for it
avis.texte: I think the B5 in this unfortunately broke me out. However, this has been amazing for dry, chapped lips. I apply it and seal it in with vaseline. Also worked wonders on an annoying patch of eczema I had on my finger that kept getting irritated from constantly washing my hands at work. I applied it nightly and it cleared up in a week. If you aren't sensitive to B5, this will probably be a great hydrator for you.

I bought this item a few months ago for my face (I have dry skin and hair) and it was okay at most for that, but my hair is a different story. I have coarse pretty thick Afro (type 4 looking) hair that gets easily dry. I decided to mix this with sunflower and tea tree oil as a detangler/prepoo and it has made a HUGE difference. I've been using it for a month on my hair and it retains moisture much better, it's soft and manageable and doesn't need as much TLC as it used to. Ive tried a lot of treatments and brands but adding this to your conditioner, prepoo and/or shampoo will make a difference for a fraction of the price!
This absolutely saved my face from a disagreement with tretinoin when hyaluronic acid did nothing. Now this is a must for my flaky winter skin.

I have been using this for a month. Went on a trip and got really sunburnt and so was trying to recover my skin….now this is literally all i need (plus spf). It makes my skin so moisturized and soft without even using any moisturizer

avis.titre: Dried out your skin instead of hydration
avis.texte: I try to purchase items regardless of reviews to try it myself but I regret my decision. This and HA both dries out your skin instead of hydration. Don't waste your money.

I bought this product as a light, water based hydration booster for my face but ended up loving it so much that I ordered 3 more bottles. Not only that it is so light and fresh on the skin (have no idea why other people are mentioning sticky finish) but it also drastically improved contact dermatitis on my fingers. Pro tip: I use it on wet hair to hydrate the ends and it makes it slightly more flexible and easier to brush. I am a female with oily to combination skin, 34 yo with rather sensitive, rosy skin.

To be completely honest, I have no idea what it is but this product is simply brilliant for me. I have dry skin, and I've used already several bottles of this product, which for me is a lot. I am not completely sure how to distinguish the effect because the changes were very subtle at first but the fact is, that using it, my skin is simply so much more hydrated, and no matter what moisturizer I use, I finally don't flake or don't feel the dry skin. In the beginning, I was using it twice per day, and I simply felt my skin was less dry. Now I'm using it just in the evening, and it feels good enough. It offers this solid, constant hydration. Very light, so it doesn't bother me on the face, a great first layer for other serums.

avis.titre: The only hydration that works for me!!
avis.texte: Am an ordinary addict and majority of my skincare consist of the 30 ml bottles! I love this as it always gives me the hydration I need as I have a very dry skin. The only reason I have not given it a 5 star is because there are some days when my skin is feeling sensitive and I cannot absolutely use this! It stings and burns and I cannot understand why. I have been using this over 3 years and I want to know that if stopping this product will reverse all the progress I have made with my skin? Also to note it would mean the world if Deciem start to add on their products label that it is completely fine for users with skin of colour, case in point the your AHA BHA peel is fantastic but its not good for ppl with SOC.

avis.titre: Amazing for repairing skin and wounds!
avis.texte: This is amazing for my dry, flaking skin. This is super hydrating and repairing. I also apply this whenever i have a wound on my face and it works like magic. It cuts the healing time in half! Never discontinue this please!!

Some weeks after I started using this, I was watching TV and inadvertently brushed the back of my hand against my cheek. Wow, it was so soft! Not like a 55 year old's skin at all. I thought what I had done differently with my skin routine and there was only one thing: using this product! So it's a no brainer now.

I had really badly chapped lips (including the skin all around my mouth) that did not go away for two months even though I tried every lip balm and skin healing ointment I could think of. I started using this and two weeks later my chapped lips were completely healed and my skin's moisture barrier was back to normal. The first time I used it, my chapped lips improved visibly overnight. I absolutely love this product!

I bought this product with squalane cleanser, ascrobyl glucoside solution 12% and natural moisturining factors +HA a months ago.I cant see any changes on my face instead a tiny red bumps came up on my skin .
I find it too liquid to put where I want it, and I have found the HA moisturizer much more powerful.

Bought this 4 months ago and am really impressed with the results. At first, I used a little too sparingly, but after watching a video explaining its benefits, I decided to be a little more generous with the amount used (after all, it's not expensive at all). And boy, what a difference! My skin feels very smooth and hydrated, my dry patches are gone and the redness and irritation are very soothed. I found that this even had healing properties. And I truly find that this helps me to compensate for the effects for some stronger products I use (acids and retinol). I use this at night before moisturizer.

I recently try to avoid hyalouronic acid (which is hard to do using Deciem products) and therefore tried this. The texture is lovely to use before or mixed with moisturizer and it's really smoothing and hydrating. Will repurchase.
I also experienced breakouts, small dots in areas I don't usually have pimples (forehead & cheeks). I see most of the people who rated this product with one star had the same issue

This brought seriously changed the way my skin looks and feels, I used to have a lot of dryness around my forehead and cheeks but the amino acids worked wonderfully to make my skin smooth. For the first few weeks I kept stroking my skin, the difference in how my skin felt was much greater than the difference in appearance.
when I apply it on the skin I feel immediate relief from dry, tight skin on my face

Mixed with my moisturiser does a great job, it's good on its own as well as long as applied on damp skin, otherwise gives a sticky feeling for a couple of hours. But best use for me was to mix it with my hair conditioner or an overnight treatment on my scalp! I'm was not sure if I could use it this way but after googling all ingredients I decided to give it a go and my damaged hair has never been shinier and stronger. Multi use serum for me!

I've been using this product for over a year now and love it! I use it as the first step in my routine. By itself, it can leave a sticky feeling, but I learned that by applying it when my face was still slightly damp, lessened the stickiness. I eliminated the stickiness by using SPF and lotion (or just lotion at night) at the end of my routine. My skin has never been more smooth. I have very sensitive and dry skin. This is one of the only products I have no trouble with. I highly recommend for a boost of hydration. But please note, in my experience, it works best when lotion is applied as well.

avis.titre: A lovely boost for your skin!
avis.texte: When it comes to serums I look for ones that will add a some extra goodness to my basic skincare routine. I feel I've found that with this product! I have combo skin and finds this works on all areas of my face. It didn't clog my pores or cause pimples, so hurray! Although I wouldn't say it could stand alone as a one and done product for hydration, it still provides support in that area. Just a note on texture, it is a tad runny. But I find it manageable by adding these drops to my moisturizer and applying both products at once. So if you're looking for extra support in your routine, I'd check this serum out!

have been using it for a month, skin feels more hydrated. it has very light texture and is easy to apply. doesn't leave any sticky or oily residue, perfect as a first layer in the routine or under moisturiser. I have very dry and sensitive aging skin, and I feel this product addresses dryness and sensitivity. Disclaimer: I use other ordinary products that address some of the same concerns.

I love this product. I have dry skin and use both morning and night (in combination with various other products) so I am going through the 30ml bottles so quickly - please please increase the size!! :)

I added this to my regimen a few weeks ago. Although I wait until the other things are absorbed, it feels sticky and does not feel as though it completely absorbs. Other than that, I have no complaints, but I'm not sure I will repurchase.

avis.titre: It worked for a week but..
avis.texte: I have been using this product for 2 weeks. It was all good, it moisturized my skin and the tackling sensation lasted 1 minute and just after the first application. Today I applied it as I normally do and some red zone appeared on my face.. I don't know what happened but I think it is irritation. I don't know why I got it after two weeks. Can someone explain it to me?

avis.titre: Great moisturizer with super light texture
avis.texte: I'm having some issues with the gel-liked products from The Ordinary. The Niacinamide + Zink and the Matrixyl Solution for example don't work for me. That is also why I prefer the Amino Acids to the Hyaluronic Acid. It has texture like water and makes my skin feel really hydrated and soft. I use it in the mornings.

avis.titre: Still on the fence about this product!
avis.texte: I have to give 3 stars to this product because, after using all the content of the bottle over the course of various months, I am still confused about whether I actually liked it or not. For a bit of context: I have dry skin, which can really only take as much in terms of the amount of products I layer, and of how thick they are; I initially bought this serum in the hopes of it providing an extra layer of hydration under my moisturiser. The aim was to avoid embarking on the never-ending quest for a light-yet-effective moisturiser that my skin could handle, so I thought this water-based would do the trick of provding extra moisture without any added heaviness. It initially caused breakouts, but they eventually faded after a few days of consistent use. So far so good. BUT what never really changed over the course of time was the sticky finish that it left my skin covered in (which I really didn't look forward to, considering that I bought it very much to avoid this thing, which also tends to happen with thicker moisturisers). Nothing I did ever really managed to solve this problem (I tried applying less of it, layering it with less products, using it by itself, applying it on damp skin to improve absorption). On this note, I very much agree with some reviews I read that claimed it left a sticky film on the skin, which resembles very much what you would be left with if you were to apply fruit juice or sugary water on your skin and let it dry. So be warned! On the other hand, I h
I have been using this in combination with vitamin c cream and moisturizer and it's staining my sheets an orange colour. Thoughts?

I'm already at my second bottle! This has been a miracle for my skin! I recently had to change my sunscreen due to the manufacturer removing the product from sale. I now use a European sunscreen with some alcohol i normally have combination-dry sensitive skin. My skin was getting so dry! A friend recommended this and i decided to try. Its veeery watery so I apply it to the palm of my hand and pat it on my skin. It instantly boosts hydration and radiance, my skin looks so radiant people think I'm wearing make up when I'm not! I sometimes use a vitamin c serum afterwards and my skin seems to love this. I highly recommend

It's a very thin consistency and easy to distribute. It leaves the skin instantly hydrated, feeling moisturised and plump. It gives a gorgeous, natural glow from within to the skin that shines through. The skin stays hydrated all day.

I had very dry skin and my forehead felt like sandpaper! I had used all kinds of moisturizer but I wasn't happy with any of them. This product is great! My skin now glows, has much more elasticity and I can feel it fresh and moisturized. It's very easy to use and not at all oily.
Was really excited for this product as I have dehydrated skin and this sounded like the perfect thing - but it's very sticky and leaves my faces tacky for hours. :(

I love this product. It goes on easy (although I find I run out of it quicker than other products but it's a great price point so it doesn't matter) and leaves my skin so plump and dewy. I have sensitive rosacea skin and this does not irritate it at all. I will keep purchasing this as a staple product.

I've been struggling with dry patches of skin on my cheekbones. Since I started using this serum (combined with the Squalene cleanser and Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA), in just a few weeks I noticed a huge improvement in my skin texture. The dry patches are completely gone and the redness is fading with every single day. I highly recommend this product - it provides great hydration and soothes the skin!

I have been using this product for many months now and my skin feels so much better with it - as soon as I stop using it for a few days, I can feel the difference that my skin is much drier. Has been an excellent addition to my routine

I didn't expect to like this so much but wanted to try a few different things for my severely dry skin that just can't hold onto moisture. At first I was disappointed because my skin didn't feel that juicy nourished plumpness you get from a lot of hydrating serums, but at the end of the day I realized my skin was STILL soft. It feels like this actually repairs the moisture barrier instead of just temporarily infusing it with moisture, so my skin feels firm and healthy. After continual use for a couple weeks, my skin actually feels healthier, even when I haven't just put it on. It also delivers quite a "shine" (even though it is NOT greasy at all) which may be too much for oilier skin types. For dry skin, I love this more than any hyaluronic acid or the Buffet!
Unfortunately this didn't work for me..brought me out in spots around my cheeks. Real shame but I do tend to have more sensitive combo skin.

For the longest time, I was using daily moisturizers w/ SPF; however, with oily skin... everyday by 3 pm, you could probably signal for help using the shine off my forehead. I switched to The Ordinary hyaluronic acid, but I always found it a hassle to wet or not fully dry my face before using it. If I didn't, the product would feel tight on my face like an invisible peel-off mask. Skeptically, I switched to the amino acids, and it's been a pleasant experience for the 5 or so months I've been using it. My skin retains a nice moisture level throughout the day into the night, and I don't look like exfoliated with a fried sausage in the afternoon. The consistency is somewhat "watery" so I use about 4-5 drops on my face and rub it in easily with my hands. IDK if this is salient, but I'm a dude. Is our skin different? *shrug emoji

personally I have oily skin, and for those who have it as well I wouldn't reccomend buying it, because it simply does nothing. I bought it as an alternative for poor quality drugstore creams, but I'd rather use them than this, because it doesn't absorb to the skin well. I have tried other products and they seem okay, but I'd pass on this one.

As someone who has tried The Ordinary's hylauronic acid and moisturiser to varying degree of success, I was starting to really stress about just how dry my skin was. No matter how much I moisturised or what I was using...my skin would always flake around my chin where I was also using acne medication. I've been using this for two months now and I've had no flaking! I feel like it really has helped repair my skin barrier and I'd even say it's plumpened my skin too. I use 4 drops on my face after washing it in the morning and then follow through with niacinimide or azaelic acid and moisturiser and my face is bright, plump and ready for foundation with no flakes! Highly recommend, first product that's really had a massive impact on how I feel about my face :)
